label: GO step, choosing a1 after a reward, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2). 96% of activation mass is on GO steps where the agent picks a1 (model_act==1; policy logit strongly favours a1, top choice bin 7x lift) and 97% follows a rewarded previous trial. It is strongly gated by time within the episode: silent in trials 0-29, and the firing rate climbs steadily to trial 99, so it looks like a slow drift in the hidden state across the episode. Magnitude grows over runs of consecutive rewarded a1 choices (examples go 0.6 -> 0.8 -> 1.0) and drops after an unrewarded trial. Value is low when it fires (it never fires in the top value bin). It essentially never fires for a2 choices or after no reward. Dev: GO & a1 & prev_reward alone gives F1 0.58; adding ep_trial>=50 gives F1 0.76, mass recall 0.90. The misses are weak activations from earlier trials (ep 30-49) or the first steps of a reward streak. No FUTURE variables are used: model_act is the agent own current choice.
